Wrangler Air in the F-100×68×50 box, schematic A, relay across

AliExpress IP65 box, black base 36 mm and clear lid 14 mm (sizes from the seller drawing, check on the real box). DinMeter in one end wall, two M12 cable glands in the other. Relay across the box next to the glands (Grove 10 cm from PORT.B; the two floor bosses under it are cut flush). Right gland: the 2 m Grove from PORT.A to the sensor and the violet ARB wire from relay NO. Left gland: power. Power: black GND, red +12 V to the DinMeter and red +12 V to relay COM (silicone 20 AWG). No ADC. Hover or tap a part for its name. For scale: Galaxy Z Fold7 folded and a cigarette pack (photo: Wikimedia Commons, AKS.9955, CC BY-SA 4.0).
